entry.title: Bitcoin Core v32.1 Released
entry.summary:
Version 32.1 of the release binaries for x86_64 Linux has experienced stability issues, as evidenced by two unexpected restarts since its deployment on anyone.eu.org. These incidents may indicate underlying problems with the new release that could affect reliability and performance.
Monitoring and further investigation are recommended to identify the root causes of these restarts. Addressing these issues promptly will help maintain optimal node operation and prevent potential disruptions for users relying on this infrastructure.
